label: Accessioning & Cataloging Suite
description: The final checkpoint where specimens are officially recorded into the museum's permanent digital and physical archives.

tools.function: Used to write catalog numbers directly onto the bone (over a base layer of B-72).
Takes the 'Official Measurements' that will be cited in scientific papers.

game_mechanics.provenance_check: If the player's field notes are missing GPS coordinates or stratigraphic data, the Curator will REJECT the specimen.
game_mechanics.accession_bonus: Successfully cataloging a rare 'Small Fauna' specimen unlocks a higher 'Museum Rank' for the player.
